restored.prev: 室內，七名穿著與派琶相似的妖精們正圍繞著一張方形的桌子討論著。「派琶，你來了。」當中唯一的長者深深看著派琶。「這些人是誰？」
restored.next: 派琶簡單介紹了冒險者，以及先前攻擊他們的芬尼爾信徒佛拉。中繼站的領導者悠馬長老，建議派琶與冒險者們先一同用晚餐，然後一起準備明天一早的撤離，但派琶說時間來不及了，吃飽後就得上路。最終，他決定帶上信使弗雷多以及斥侯雙胞胎兄弟達羅與達里兩人飯後上路，其餘人員則隔日與冒險者們一起出發。

restored.prev: Indoors, seven goblins dressed similarly to Py'Par were discussing around a square table. "Py'Par, you are here." The only elder among them looked at Py'Par deeply. "Who are these people?"
restored.next: Py'Par briefly introduced the adventurers and the Phyneal believer Phola who attacked them previously. Keeper Yoma, the leader of the relay station, suggested that Py'Par and the adventurers have dinner together first, and then prepare to evacuate early tomorrow morning, but Py'Par said that there was not enough time, and they had to hit the road after eating. In the end, he decided to take the messenger Fre'Do and the scout twin brothers Daro and Dari on the road after dinner, while the rest of the team set off with the adventurers the next day.

browser.note: Local Chrome; external requests and Service Workers blocked. Tests initialize the language per viewport and explicitly assert innerWidth after setViewportSize. Earlier test setup retained the previous language and passed viewport options to context.newPage, which ignores them; corrected setup and repeated all four language/viewport checks. Deleted URLs and canonical image checks passed in the preceding run. Physical devices and production deployment not tested.

data.contentCheck: Only two inline-image objects added, one in each language; all previous JSON content is unchanged. Removal source hashes matched the preceding review.
data.recovery: Removed images remain recoverable from Git history. No new Storage backup or redirect was created. Changes are local and not deployed.

data.scope: Local HTTPS with the actual v27 worker upgraded by shared/pwa.js to v28. Desktop and 390px Chrome, genuine offline reload and ten native image documents opened from Cache Storage. External origins blocked; no Storage uploads or source switches. Production acceptance follows deployment.

validation.note: Offline only. Both current source originals and staging backups matched hashes; all variants decoded and matched manifest dimensions. No network or cloud mutations.

letterBrowser.note: Local Chrome, network restricted to loopback; contact sheets rendered offline. Checks native image document opened by keyboard, not physical mobile pinch gestures.
